issues.explanation: Chapter 42 repeats糜夫人’s death and赵云掩井, already narrated in Chapter 41, then repeats it again in赵云’s report to刘备. The opening recap also places the death after the钟缙、钟绅 encounter, whereas the source places it before that encounter.
issues.suggested_fix: Delete the opening recap of糜夫人’s death; begin with赵云 defeating钟缙、钟绅 and fleeing to长坂桥, leaving the later report to刘备 as the only brief reminder.
